title: Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases: HUD Steps and Calling the Loan Due
content:
## 1. HUD step

Under Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases, HUD is notified of a death or sale, or asked to approve calling the loan due for any other event, within the plan's HUD notice days. The period is counted in calendar days from the opened date. On a Cedarline Summit loan no HUD step applies, following the plan's Summit HUD setting, and the loan is called due on the opened date.

## 2. Approval before the call

A loan whose plan requires HUD approval is called due only after a HUD approval-received step is recorded on the case. The authority is the case history held by Cedarline before the call, matched to that case. Each HUD step is recorded once per extension number on the case; a second entry of the same step for the same extension number is not made.

## 3. The day the loan is called due

| Case situation | Day the loan is called due |
|---|---|
| death or sale case | the day the due-and-payable notification to HUD is recorded |
| case awaiting approval | the day approval is recorded |
| deferred case | the day its deferral ends |
| Summit loan (no HUD step) | the opened date |

## 4. Property charge default

Approval is requested only when both of the following hold:

- the unrepaid property-charge advances on the loan exceed the plan's property charge default threshold;
- the borrower has not cured within the plan's default notice cure days, counted in calendar days from the default notice.

At or below the threshold, the case stays opened under monitoring.

## 5. Dates fixed when the loan is called due

- The due-and-payable date is that day.
- *Retired wording, no longer in force:* "the response deadline is the plan's successor response days calendar days after that day, because the due-and-payable notice is sent the same day". This wording has been superseded by the current basis.
- The resolution deadline is the same day number the plan's resolution period months later, in calendar months after the due-and-payable date. Where that day does not exist, it falls back to the last day of that month.

### Resolution deadline, hypothetical dates (six-month period)

| Due-and-payable date | Resolution deadline |
|---|---|
| 14 January | 14 July |
| 31 August | the last day of February (no 31 February exists) |
| 30 September | 30 March |

superseded_clauses: response_deadline is successor_response_days calendar days after that day, because the due-and-payable notice is sent the same day
